hero.lead: A nation of 10.8 million with a €21.9 billion recovery and resilience plan and two thirds of its power renewable.

capital.heading: Clean power and recovery, and a living income for all.

record.text: Recovery and resilience plan: €21.905 billion, the final revised allocation, completed by the tenth and last payment request of 29 September 2026
General government gross debt, share of GDP, 2025

register.name: Recovery and resilience plan
register.detail: European Union · Final revised allocation · Tenth and last payment request submitted 29 September 2026
register.text: EU funding, in grants and loans, for agreed reforms and investments; all 379 milestones and targets reported as met.

register.name: IFRRU 2030 rental housing line
register.detail: European Investment Bank · Signed 4 November 2026 · Build-to-Rent and Renovate-to-Rent
register.text: Loans through financial intermediaries to build and renovate homes for rent at affordable or moderate prices. It is aimed at the shelter standard.

register.name: Extreme weather recovery package
register.detail: European Investment Bank Group · Announced 27 October 2026 · Expected by the end of 2026
register.text: Financing for the Republic to rebuild municipal infrastructure damaged by extreme weather, and a loan to Banco Português de Fomento for reconstruction by small and mid-sized firms.
register.note: €250 million to the Republic; €500 million to Banco Português de Fomento

register.name: Social housing framework loan
register.detail: European Investment Bank · First €500 million tranche signed 7 September 2026 · Local Housing Strategies
register.text: About 50,000 social homes built or renovated by the municipalities for families on low incomes. It is aimed at the shelter standard.

register.name: Affordable housing framework loan
register.detail: European Investment Bank · First €450 million tranche signed 18 September 2025
register.text: About 12,000 affordable rental homes, let at rents below the market.

register.name: InvestEU Fomento-FEI
register.detail: Government of Portugal · Announced 11 July 2025 · Largest InvestEU national compartment in Europe
register.text: Lending expected to be mobilised for more than 40,000 small firms, small mid-caps and individuals, through Banco Português de Fomento and the European Investment Fund. It is aimed at the livelihood standard.
register.note: Backed by €450 million of the recovery plan, a €50 million State guarantee and €490 million of EIF resources

items.name: The Farmland

items.name: The Fresh Water

items.text: Rain and rivers renewed every year: power, irrigation and drinking water.
